घुर् {c6c} P. (घुरति, घुरित)
1 To
sound, make a noise, snore, snort;
grunt (as a pig, dog &c.); कः कः
कुत्र न घुर्घुरायितघुरीघोरो घुरेच्छूकरः
K.

.
--2 To be frightful or terrible.
--3 To cry in distress.

घुरघुरायते Den. A. To utter
gurgling sounds.

घुरी The nostrils, especially of a
hog; घुर्घुरायितघुरीघोरो घुरेच्छूकरः
K.

1 Guinea-worm.
--2
Snorting, growling, grumbling.
--रा
Growling &c. (as of a dog).

घुर्घुरायते Den. A. To murmur,
hum, whisper.

1 The grunting of a hog.
--2 The mole-cricket.

घूर्ण् {c1c} A., {c6c} P. [घूर्णते, घूर्णति, घूर्णित]
To roll about, move to and fro,
whirl, turn round, shake, reel,
stagger; योषितामतिमदेन जुघूर्णु
र्विभ्रमातिशयपूंषि वपूंषि Śi. 10. 32;
भयात्केचिदघूणिषुः

. --Caus.
(घूर्णयति-ते) To cause to shake, reel
or roll about; नयनान्यरुणानि घूर्णयन्

(with prepositions like आ, वि the
root retains the same meaning).

घूर्ण a. Shaking, moving to and
fro.
--र्णः Whirling, rolling.
--Comp.
--वायुः a whirlwind.

घूर्णनं, --ना [घुण्-भावे-ल्युट्] Shaking,
reeling, whirling or turning round,
revolving; मौलिघूर्णनचलत्

घूर्णनं, --ना [घुण्-भावे-ल्युट्] Shaking,
reeling, whirling or turning round,
revolving; मौलिघूर्णनचलत्
